scenarios.prompt: Stage a config/client rollout to a cohort, observe health evidence, then promote it. Record minimum client, schema compatibility and rollback target.

criteria.compatibility: Minimum client and schema/data compatibility are known before activation.
criteria.rollout: Staged rollout/cohort/health evidence and rollback target are explicit.
criteria.persistence: Rollback considers newer persistent data and does not duplicate grants or corrupt saves.
